title: FX249 an environment without a network: the move
caption: Louis runs infra from the branch first, so the merge's own release creates the apps in the new group while the old ones keep serving. Each name gets its certificate on the new app, then its record moves in Cloudflare. Only when both sites answer from the new environment are the old pieces deleted.
